subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Air
overview: Fly to Xiamen with Xiamen Air, then on to Changsha, and travel by private coach to Furong Town, the ancient town hanging on a waterfall, and Zhangjiajie. You see the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park), Avatar Hallelujah Mountain and the Grand Canyon glass bridge. You stay in a local 4★ hotel in Xiamen and 5★ hotels in Changsha and Zhangjiajie, with an English-speaking guide throughout.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 6–12 2026 to Mar 12–18 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Xiamen
items: Fly Manila – Xiamen (departs 21:20, arrives 23:35); meet the tour guide at Xiamen Gaoqi airport
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Xiamen – Changsha
items: Breakfast at the hotel, check out
Huwei Mountain of the Xiamen Mountains-to-Sea Trail
Free time at Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street (lunch on your own)
Gather at 13:30 and transfer to the airport; fly Xiamen – Changsha (16:00 – 17:45)
Meet the guide in Changsha, dinner, then transfer to the hotel

itinerary.title: Changsha – Furong Town – Zhangjiajie
items: Furong Town, the ancient town hanging on the waterfall (including cruise and battery cart)
Proceed to Zhangjiajie; dinner, then transfer to the hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie Avatar Scenic Area
items: Avatar scenic area (up and down by Bailong Lift or Tianzishan cable car)
Golden Whip Stream and Water Around Four Gates
Compulsory shopping stop: Chinese medicine shop
Dinner, then back to the hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie
items: Optional tours on the day (see Optional tours); dinner, then back to the hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Changsha
items: Tea tasting at a tea shop
Grand Canyon C Line and the glass bridge

itinerary.title: Changsha – Xiamen – Manila
items: Free time at Huangxing Road walking street (arranged according to the flight time)
Fly Changsha – Xiamen (13:15 – 14:55), then Xiamen – Manila (17:35 – 20:20)

placeDesc.Xiamen: A coastal city in Fujian where the tour begins, with seaside scenery and a pedestrian shopping street.
placeDesc.Huwei Mountain: A hill in Xiamen on the Mountains-to-Sea Trail, visited for views over the coast.
placeDesc.Xiamen University Baicheng Coast: The beach and coastline beside Xiamen University, a popular scenic seaside spot.
placeDesc.Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street: Xiamen's old-style pedestrian shopping street, given as free time with lunch on your own.
placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient town in Hunan built on a cliff beside a large waterfall; the visit includes a cruise and battery cart.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie Avatar Scenic Area: A national forest park of tall sandstone pillars, linked to the scenery of the Avatar movie.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A large outdoor glass elevator that carries visitors up the cliff face at Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Tianzishan: A scenic mountain area in the Zhangjiajie region, reached by cable car as an alternative to the Bailong Lift.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge in Zhangjiajie, a viewpoint within the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: A floating-style sandstone peak in Zhangjiajie that is linked to the Avatar movie scenery.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic walking stream valley in Zhangjiajie, with the Water Around Four Gates viewpoint.
placeDesc.Water Around Four Gates: A viewpoint along the Golden Whip Stream in Zhangjiajie, visited together with the stream.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum in the Zhangjiajie area showing artworks made from local coloured sandstone.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-bottomed bridge over a deep canyon near Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Huangxing Road Walking Street: Changsha's busy pedestrian shopping street, used for free time before the flight.
